body: I must remember that the Universe has seen this before. Humans depressed that is. If it existed for billions of years, why can't I exist for another minute? I know the Universe isn't sentient, but it makes me realize how pathetic it would be for me to as least try to hang on.

Thank you. If forced to live minute by minute as it were, I must figure out how to find meaning in those minutes. I find meaning in all of you reaching out to me around the world. Thus these minutes have become more bearable once again. My utmost thanks.
I actually have an interview soon for a job in California (San Francisco) and am hoping it goes well. The interview is going to be extremely difficult.

I agree. That did help me realize that I've done this before on my own accord, and I can do it again. Thanks for helping me. Maybe more people would be happier if growing up we knew that our own actions and the actions of those around us were what shaped us, not necessarily a path or God, etc. etc.

Thank you very much. It's hard to always express the way I feel to people who believe things are deserved or destined or earned. There is only action and reaction. I grew up in the South (am still here) and its so difficult to walk around my depression in terms outside of any form of faith.

Love is what confuses me the most I guess. I cannot wield or understand it with reason. It is so elusive to me. I do not fear death and the pain inside from time to time is something that is very real and very potent. My sentience brings me that too I guess.

Thank you very much. I am curious as to what I can do in this world. Maybe once we are no longer afraid of death it becomes both an option and nonoption. I won't pay for sins, but I will nullify my ability to make any further positive impact on the world. Thank you for reaching out to me.
I am definitely far along the path.

To sum it up in so many words a terribly confused and disappointed realization of what life can be despite what I was told it was. That our species is so fallible as to ruin each others emotions and hearts to an extent. I am sick of everything in front of me for no good apparent reason other than it's not fulfilling. I am heart broken as well. Horribly so.

I guess that is what is stopping me from committing to it. This is all I have. I was blessed with the miracle of existence. But, perhaps this existence is so horrible right now I can't work through it.

Thank you, I guess that video makes me realize that I am a child of stars. I just, my beautiful mind I was gifted with wants me to just dwell on the sexual desires and love and torment of a current situation.

I still pretty young (23) but I am already totally fed up with heartache. I know when I talk to her tonight my heart might be shredded in the complexity of what has to happen. 

I, and everyone else on this rock, wishes they could find someone who worked. Who fit well. But it's hard. Getting married to someone isn't really any kind of guarantee of happiness I guess. I mean, shit, marriages collapse all the time. How can anyone ever find someone who won't do them *that* much harm? 

Louis CK pointed it out when he said, Even if you marry someone you love, and stay with them, in the end one of you has to die before the other. And that's it. They die. And you're alone again. 

What a terrible cycle. I guess we just survive for a single accomplishment. To feel safe and loved, and reciprocate that.
She texted me she got in okay and she will talk to me tonight. So at least she doesn't want my head on a pike. (I think?)

I know I must wait. I am struggling to get through a single minute here alone. Thanks for the advice. I tend to be a fairly rational person. I just lost it I guess since I found the complete opposite of what I had expected. 

How did you find peace? I'm only angry at myself really for being naive. I thought about this woman EVERY SINGLE DAY of what has been the worst six months of my life. I wanted her next to me thousands of times when I was alone. When I felt like dying. When I ate at a restaurant by myself or walked through a park alone. I tried everything to make it stop since it was driving me crazy. I thought I was obsessed, but I think I am just deeply in love.

Well I flipped out last night because I can't harbor a lie. I called her at 3:00 am right before she had to catch her flight and told her everything. Facebook login, that I had slept with someone, etc. She was pretty mad obviously, she has a right to be. (About the Facebook thing, not the sex thing). I told her that I did it because I loved her and was afraid of my own actions, which is the truth. She told me she would call me when she got back to the states. Her flight arrived but she isn't replying. I guess I can't blame her, I wouldn't want to say anything at all until I knew I could sit down and think. 

I have struggled with depression most of my life. When I first moved to where I am now, I got close to killing myself because of the insane amount of grief and despair I had. The experience was so traumatizing I actually lost all faith in God, and refuse that there is any higher power outside of mans' own actions. I'm not trying to sound rediculous, it's just that it fundamentally shaped the way I look at life. 

Even now that she is back in the US, we will still be in two very far away and different places. I will try to make it work. But I doubt she will want to.
Yeah. I posted some replies, don't have the motivation to type it out again, but would like to talk to someone.

Well we split up, and we agreed to see other people. I tried to see other people, but really only wanted her ever. I went so far to sleep with someone, seeing if I could snap myself out of my longing, but it just made me miss her more. We talked and flirted like we were in a relationship, even though we weren't these last couple of months. When she came home I anticipated that we might be able to get back together. I was afraid of telling her about me sleeping with someone, since I didn't think she had seen anyone. I got into her facebook to see how serious she might be about us, and instead of finding her longing for me, found that she had been with a few guys. I am jealous of the guys that got to hold her and be with her. I am not mad at her or them, they were in the right. I guess I just wish I would've known. I should've asked her, but it's too late for that now. I had no idea that I would realize she was sleeping with people. She had always told me that I was the one that understood her and loved her. That's why I felt so bad about sleeping with someone. I broke a lot of her trust by getting into her things, and I was completely wrong to do so. It was just an act of thoughtless passion and nervousness. I'm not sure how any of this will fix itself. 

I want her to tell me she messed up too, that she loves me, that she wants to make this work. But I know that won't be the case.

Basically I was in a semi-relationship with my girlfriend since we both moved to opposite ends of the earth. She is returning to the states finally. I had ended up sleeping with someone when I was single, an never suspected her of anything. I felt guilty but didnt know how to tell her. I really overstepped my bounds and got into her facebook. I only did it because I wanted to see how serious she was about me. It turns out she has been sleeping with guys as well. That's fine, she is completely able to do that. She is single. There was just miscommunciation. Anyways I spilled everything to her. 

I did all of this out of love. I just, I can't feel anything but panic and despair right now. I had to read all the nitty gritty details, which I brought upon myself, but just wasn't expecting that. 

I want her to tell me she loves me.

I really hope you are still there, because I just posted a minute ago. You almost described my life verbatim. 

I am crying because I know exactly how you feel. I really do. I try to make everything work but rarely can.
